scripts.clean: powershell if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item dist -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path extension.zip) { Remove-Item extension.zip -Force }
scripts.build: npx -y esbuild src/popup/popup.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/popup.js --format=iife --target=chrome100 && npx -y esbuild src/background/service-worker.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/service-worker.js --format=iife --target=chrome100 && powershell Copy-Item src/popup/popup.html dist/popup.html
scripts.prod: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run zip
